news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 1.4% Last year net profit margin: 5.9% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. news.title: Globtier Infotech Limited Appoints Shivani Gupta as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 8, 2025
news.body: Globtier Infotech Limited at its board of directors meeting held on January 8, 2025, based on the recommendations of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, has approved the appointment of Ms. Shivani Gupta as new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the company with effect from January 8, 2025. Ms. Shivaniis an Associate Member of Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) and a B.Com graduate. She has 2 years' experience in the domain of Company Secretarial Functions, Legal Affairs, Statutory Compliances & Corporate Governance.
